subject: Porting analysis from mm10 to GRCm39

messages.author: 5f5f553f2d4d45b6
messages.subject: Porting analysis from mm10 to GRCm39
parts: This might be a very naive question, but what is the best way to convert a cross object that was originally created with mm10 GM marker positions to GRCm39?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Porting analysis from mm10 to GRCm39
parts:
The mmconvert package has a function cross2_to_grcm39() to do exactly this, in cases where the genotypes are from GigaMUGA or MegaMUGA arrays.

karl
